title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: painting
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Internal painting
swms.task: Paint the apartment and corridor walls and ceilings with water-based paint by brush and roller, sanding between coats.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the water-based paints are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.

swms.title: Airless spray painting
swms.task: Spray paint the stairwells and car park walls with airless spray equipment and solvent-based paint.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the solvent-based paint are kept at the work area: flammable, use with ventilation, keep away from ignition sources, wear a respirator, gloves and eye protection.

swms.title: External painting from boom lifts
swms.task: Paint the external podium walls from boom lifts, with water-based paint.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the water-based paints are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.fallControl: Painters work from elevating work platforms (boom lifts) with guardrails, and harnesses clipped to the platform anchor point.
facts.harnessSystem: Workers wear a full body harness with a restraint lanyard short enough that they cannot be thrown from the basket, clipped to the boom lift anchor point. Harnesses and lanyards are checked by the user before each use and inspected by a competent person every 6 months, recorded on the tag. Users are trained in working at heights and boom lift operation by a registered training organisation.

steps: Paint the outside of the structure at height

rules.phrase: Use water-based paint instead of solvent-based paint where possible
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 341, s 344, s 346
rules.quote: using a water-based paint rather than a solvent-based paint
